title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
summary: A sweeping account of how Homo sapiens came to dominate the planet, from the cognitive revolution through farming and empires to science and modern capitalism. It argues that shared stories and myths made large-scale cooperation possible.
readIf: you enjoy big-picture history that questions things most people take for granted.
skipIf: you want detailed, tightly sourced scholarship rather than broad, opinionated generalizations.
